detail.longDescription: You keep tracking funding news. You rotate through trade press, LinkedIn, and keep listening for signals in your network. Somewhere in that rotation, a busy month swallows your attention whole, and one of the companies in your watchlist closes a Series B. By then, a competitor has already secured a deal; that promising lead is now just a stale row in your CRM. The Crunchbase API is the tool to let go of manual tracking. With it, you can stop refreshing feeds and let the data come to you instead.
